messages:
maya: Quick async standup — posting current GPU pool status and asks. TL;DR: EU buffer low, US burst healthy, opening quota ticket.

maya: What I did: finished the autoscale fix on eu-west1 (decreased cooldown), ran a drain test on one p4d node, validated KV cache migration.

maya: Blockers: cloud quota for GPUs in eu-west1 is at 94% of our reserved pool, GCP denied the increase via portal. Need a sales-backed quota request.

jonathan: Thanks. Can you paste the quota IDs + project? I can loop in the AM account team. Also what was the drain test result?

maya: Project: rwd-infer-prod-eu (project: rwd-prod-eu-3), quotaID: gcp-gpu-quota-2102. Drain test: failed once due to kubelet eviction timing, added 30s wait before cordon, second attempt succeeded.

liam: FYI we're seeing a small uptick in ephemeral jobs from the internal perf harness — ~30% of short-run batch jobs hitting p4d. I trimmed default batch size to 64.

sara: Heads up, we have a scheduled security scan tomorrow that will reduce available instances in us-east-1 by ~6 GPUs for 2 hours. Marking that on the runbook.

maya: Noted. Can we leverage spot fallback in us-east-1 for that window? We should adjust routing policy to prefer dedicated then spot.

jonathan: I can add a temporary routing rule: prefer-dedicated -> spot-compat if dedicated < 20% headroom. Will push a canary config later today.

maya: Filed quota ticket with GCP support: https://console.cloud.google.com/support/cases/CASE-91234 — added account team as cc. Ops-bot, can you remind me of the current headroom numbers?

ops-bot: fleet-summary: eu-west1: total_reserved=320 GPUs, used=299, headroom=21; us-east-1: total_reserved=640, used=512, headroom=128; ap-southeast1: total_reserved=160, used=140, headroom=20

liam: Small ask: can we make the prewarm buffer in ap-southeast1 32 -> 48 for next 48h? We're expecting load for the APAC trial. If quota permits.

maya: +1 — approve if quota and cost OK. If quota blocked, fallback is to shift some jobs to us-east-1 via cross-region routing.

jonathan: I'll open a ticket to finance for short-term buffer increase. Ticket #FIN-4587.

sara: quick CR ping @liam — batch-size-change PR awaiting review: rwd/infra#842. Non-blocking but would be good to merge before APAC trial.

liam: On it, reviewing now. Expect to merge in next 30m.

maya: Thanks all. Action items: jonathan to engage account team for quota, liam to merge PR and adjust prewarm if approved, sara to update runbook for security window, maya to track quota case. I'll post an update once GCP responds. :thumbsup:
